prompts.map: Reconstruct an object ground-center map from ONLY the supplied RGB images and action receipts. The starting camera is the origin; initial forward is +y, initial right is +x. Units are meters. Camera height is 1.55 m, horizontal field of view is 90 degrees, images are 512 x 512. Actions rotate clockwise first and then move forward; a blocked or partial action must not be assumed to achieve its entire requested displacement. Each receipt describes the action preceding its image. Track camera orientation and object identity across views. Think carefully. Report only objects supported by the images, merge repeated views of the same instance, and use null coordinates when localization is unsupported. Do not invent unseen objects. Return final JSON with this schema: {"frame":"start_camera_xy","units":"meters","objects":[{"id":"stable_instance","category":"generic category","x":0.0,"y":0.0}],"stop_reason":"readout"}. You have no tools and no further observations.
prompts.vision: Examine this single RGB image (512 x 512). Identify each visible object instance, including partially visible instances, but exclude the floor, walls, ceiling, and structural platforms. Think carefully. Use generic object categories. Give tight bounding boxes around the visible part of each object in pixel coordinates, with x increasing right and y increasing down (0 to 511). Do not infer objects hidden entirely behind other objects or outside the image. Return final JSON only: {"objects":[{"id":"instance_1","category":"generic category","bbox":[0,0,100,100]}]}. Each bbox is [left,top,right,bottom].
